description: Replaces an existing Sentry metric alert rule's configuration; fields not provided in the request are removed or reset. This action updates an existing metric alert rule. Note that this is a full replacement - any fields not provided will be removed or reset to defaults. Prerequisites: - The organization must have metric alerts feature enabled - The alert_rule_id must be a valid existing metric alert rule - Use sentry.fetch_organization_alert_rules to get existing alert rule IDs

inputSchema.description: Defines the configuration for updating a Sentry organization's metric alert rule.

activationCondition.description: Optional condition for rule activation, used with certain `monitorType` values.
activationCondition.title: Activation Condition

aggregate.description: Aggregate function for the metric (e.g., `count`, `p95`). See Sentry's 'Metric Alert Rule Types' documentation for configurations based on dataset and query type.
aggregate.title: Aggregate

alert_rule_id.description: Unique numeric ID of the metric alert rule to update.
alert_rule_id.title: Alert Rule Id

comparisonDelta.description: Comparison period (minutes) for percentage change thresholds (e.g., 'X% higher than Y minutes ago'). Required if `thresholdType` implies percentage change; not for 'Crash Free...' alerts.
comparisonDelta.title: Comparison Delta

dataset.description: Dataset to query (`events`, `transactions`, `metrics`, `sessions`, `generic-metrics`). Affects available fields/aggregations; see Sentry's 'Metric Alert Rule Types' docs.
dataset.title: Dataset

environment.description: Environment to filter events/metrics (e.g., 'production'). If omitted, applies to all environments.
environment.title: Environment

eventTypes.description: Specific event types for this alert (e.g., `default`, `error`, `transaction`).
eventTypes.title: Event Types

monitorType.description: Monitoring state of the rule (e.g., continuously active or conditionally activated via `activationCondition`).
monitorType.title: Monitor Type

name.description: Descriptive name for the alert rule.
name.title: Name

organization_id_or_slug.description: Unique identifier (ID or slug) of the Sentry organization.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

owner.description: Sentry actor ID (e.g., `team:123`, `user:456`) owning the rule, determining management permissions.
owner.title: Owner

projects.description: List of project slugs to scope the alert rule.
projects.title: Projects

query.description: Sentry search query to filter events/metrics. An empty string (`''`) applies no filter.
query.title: Query

queryType.description: Query type, often related to `dataset`: `0` (error events), `1` (transaction events), `2` (none). See Sentry's 'Metric Alert Rule Types' for valid combinations.
queryType.title: Query Type

resolveThreshold.description: Metric value for alert resolution. If unspecified, derived from lowest severity trigger. If `thresholdType` is `0` ('Above'), `resolveThreshold` must be < critical threshold to resolve when metric drops below this value; if `1` ('Below'), it must be > critical threshold to resolve when metric rises above this value.
resolveThreshold.title: Resolve Threshold

thresholdType.description: Comparison operator for thresholds: `0` for 'Above' (metric > threshold) or 'Higher than' (percentage change), `1` for 'Below' (metric < threshold) or 'Lower than'.
thresholdType.title: Threshold Type

timeWindow.description: Time window in minutes for `aggregate` computation (1, 5, 10, 15, 30, 60, 120, 240, 1440).
timeWindow.title: Time Window

triggers.description: List of trigger configurations defining alert conditions (critical/warning labels, thresholds) and notification actions (e.g., email, Slack). `critical` label is mandatory. See Sentry API docs for full action schema.
triggers.title: Triggers

Details of the updated metric alert rule.

The response contains the complete alert rule configuration including all
settings, triggers, and metadata for the metric alert rule.
